references.title: 10+ Things to Know About the New AirTag 2
Apple just changed AirTag 2's anti-stalking feature
The 9 Best Bluetooth Trackers To Buy In 2026

en.commentary:
I ranked these nine trackers around one real-world question: when you lose something, how fast do you actually get it back? That comes down to three things. The size of the finding network behind the tag, since a tracker is only as good as the number of strangers' phones that can anonymously relay its location. The precision of the last few meters, when you're on your hands and knees under a car seat. And whether the battery outlasts your patience for replacing it.

AirTag 2 takes the top spot because Find My runs quietly on hundreds of millions of iPhones worldwide, which means a lost tag gets picked up almost anywhere you travel. The new U2 chip adds real range to Precision Finding, and the louder speaker is the first AirTag I've used that I can actually hear from across a parking garage. If you carry an iPhone, nothing else in this field matches that reach.

Galaxy SmartTag2 earns the Android equivalent of that spot. SmartThings Find has grown into a genuinely large network in its own right, and Samsung backs it with the best battery life here, up to 700 days in Power Saving Mode on a battery you can replace yourself at home.

Pebblebee's Clip 5 and Card 5 solve a problem Apple and Samsung can't: mixed households. Running on both Find My and Find Hub simultaneously makes them the right call whenever an iPhone and a Pixel share the same front door. Tile still earns its spot through sheer legacy reach and the loudest ring in the test, but I'd only buy into it if I were already paying for a Life360 family plan.

highlights.title: AirTag 2 wins on network size alone
highlights.body: Precision Finding range and the louder speaker are nice upgrades, but the real reason AirTag 2 sits at number one is the Find My network itself. Every iPhone running iOS quietly and anonymously relays Bluetooth signals from nearby AirTags, which means a lost tag in an airport in another country has a real shot at reporting its location within hours. No competitor here has a network anywhere close to that size, and that gap is what separates a tracker you can trust on a trip from one you only trust around the house.

highlights.title: SmartTag2 has the best battery in this category
highlights.body: Up to 700 days in Power Saving Mode is the longest runtime of any tracker in this ranking, and it comes on a user-replaceable CR2032 cell you swap in seconds. Pair that with IP67 water and dust resistance and UWB-powered Compass View for directional finding, and SmartTag2 is the tracker I'd hand to someone who wants to set it up once and forget about it for two years.

highlights.title: Pebblebee is the only brand that treats dual-platform households seriously
highlights.body: Clip 5 and Card 5 both pair with Apple Find My and Google Find Hub on the same physical tag, which solves a real and common problem: a household split between iPhone and Android gets full network coverage from a single purchase that covers every family member. The rechargeable battery and Qi charging on Card 5 also mean you're not stockpiling coin cells.

highlights.title: Tile only makes sense if you're already in the Life360 ecosystem
highlights.body: Tile Pro's 400-foot range and genuinely loud ring are real strengths, and the brand's decade-plus head start gives it a bigger third-party network than any newcomer. But Tile's finding network is smaller than Apple's or Google's by a wide margin, so I only recommend it to households already paying for Life360's family-location features, where the tracker becomes a free add-on bundled right into the plan.

zh-tw.commentary:
這次排名我只問一個很實際的問題，東西真的不見的時候，你多快能找回來。這其實取決於三件事。第一是防丟器背後尋找網路的規模，畢竟能幫你回報位置的陌生人手機越多，防丟器才越有用。第二是最後幾公尺的定位精準度，就是你趴在車底椅子下面找東西的那個瞬間。第三是電池夠不夠耐用，不然換電池換到煩。

AirTag 2 能拿第一名，說真的就是因為「尋找」網路這件事。全球數億台 iPhone 默默在背景幫忙回報附近 AirTag 的位置，所以就算你把東西搞丟在國外機場，也有機會在幾小時內收到定位。新的 U2 晶片讓精確尋找的距離變遠了，喇叭也是我用過最大聲的一代，在停車場隔了好幾個車位都聽得到。如果你平常用 iPhone，這塊市場目前真的沒有對手。

Galaxy SmartTag2 則是 Android 陣營的對應選擇。SmartThings Find 這幾年自己也養出一個不小的網路，加上電池續航是這份榜單裡最猛的，省電模式最長可以撐到 700 天，重點是電池自己可以換，不用整組寄回原廠回收。

Pebblebee 的 Clip 5 和 Card 5 解決了蘋果跟三星都解決不了的問題，就是家裡 iPhone 跟 Android 混用的狀況。這兩款同時吃蘋果「尋找」和 Google Find Hub 的網路，家人手機品牌不同也完全不用擔心。Tile 系列靠的是資歷夠老加上鈴聲夠大聲還留有一席之地，不過老實說，如果你本來就沒有在付 Life360 家人方案的錢，我會建議你把預算留給其他選項。

highlights.title: AirTag 2 光靠網路規模就贏了
highlights.body: 精確尋找的距離變遠、喇叭變大聲，這些升級都不錯，但 AirTag 2 能排第一名，真正的關鍵還是「尋找」網路本身。所有 iPhone 都會默默幫忙中繼附近 AirTag 的藍牙訊號，完全匿名也不耗電，所以就算東西掉在國外的機場，也有機會幾小時內就回報位置。這份榜單裡沒有任何一個對手的網路規模能跟它比，這個差距才是「出國能放心帶」跟「只能在家附近用」的分水嶺。

highlights.title: SmartTag2 的電池續航是這份榜單裡最猛的
highlights.body: 省電模式下最長可以撐 700 天，是這裡所有防丟器中續航最久的，而且用的還是可以自己換的 CR2032 鈕扣電池，不是封死的充電電池。再加上 IP67 防水防塵，以及靠 UWB 實現的指南針模式直接指方向找東西，SmartTag2 是我會推薦給那種設定好就懶得再管它、兩年後再說的朋友。

highlights.title: Pebblebee 是唯一認真照顧跨平台家庭的品牌
highlights.body: Clip 5 和 Card 5 同一顆實體防丟器就能同時連上蘋果「尋找」和 Google Find Hub，這剛好解決一個很常見的狀況，家裡一半人用 iPhone 一半人用 Android，買一顆就能涵蓋兩邊網路，不用因為家人手機品牌不同而分別買不同牌子的防丟器。Card 5 還支援 Qi 無線充電，也不用囤一堆鈕扣電池備用。

highlights.title: Tile 只適合已經在用 Life360 的人
highlights.body: Tile Pro 400 英呎的藍牙距離跟真的很大聲的鈴聲都是實打實的優點，十幾年的品牌資歷也讓它的第三方網路規模比新進品牌大上不少。不過說實話，Tile 的尋找網路規模跟蘋果或 Google 比起來還是差一截，所以我只會推薦給本來就有在付 Life360 家人定位方案的人，這樣防丟器等於是附加的免費功能，而不是單獨要再花一筆錢買。

references.title: Samsung's new AirTag rival works with more than just Galaxy phones
Samsung's new SmartTag 3 looks a lot like an AirTag
Samsung's New SmartTag 3 Item Tracker Works With iPhones

en.commentary: Apple's AirTag 2 keeps the top spot, and the clearest challenge to the entire category arrives within days. Samsung's Galaxy SmartTag 3 launches in Korea and the US on October 7, and the spec sheet is a real step forward, triple the range of its predecessor at up to 60 meters using Bluetooth 6.0 channel sounding, 35 percent smaller and 33 percent lighter, up to 550 days of battery life, and for the first time it works with iPhones as well as Galaxy phones. That last detail matters most, Samsung's current SmartTag2 holds second place here largely because of a 10.0 ecosystem score tied to Samsung Find My network size, and if SmartTag 3 genuinely works across iOS too, that cross platform support closes the single biggest gap between it and AirTag 2's own perfect 10.0 ecosystem score. None of that changes today's ranking since SmartTag 3 hasn't shipped yet and I haven't seen it tested, but it's the single most important product to watch in this category over the next month. Pebblebee's Clip 5 holds third with a 9.0 ecosystem score of its own, still a strong pick if you want both Apple Find My and Google's network support working through one tracker.

highlights.title: SmartTag 3 Arrives October 7
highlights.body: Samsung's next tracker launches in Korea and the US with triple the Bluetooth range of its predecessor, a smaller and lighter body, and up to 550 days of battery life.

highlights.title: iPhone Support Is the Real Story
highlights.body: SmartTag 3 reportedly works with iPhones for the first time, the one feature that could finally close the ecosystem gap between Samsung's tracker and AirTag 2.

highlights.title: Nothing Changes Here Until It Ships
highlights.body: SmartTag 3 hasn't launched or been independently tested yet, so today's ranking holds, but it's the single product most worth watching in this category over the next month.

highlights.title: Pebblebee Still Wins on Cross Platform Support
highlights.body: A 9.0 ecosystem score reflects support for both Apple Find My and Google's network in one tracker, a real advantage for anyone who switches between phone platforms.

zh-tw.commentary:
Apple 的AirTag 2還是穩坐冠軍，但這整個品類最直接的挑戰，再過幾天就要上市了。三星的Galaxy SmartTag 3將在10月7日於韓國跟美國開賣，規格表看起來是真的往前邁了一大步，用Bluetooth 6.0的通道感測技術，把定位距離拉長到前代的三倍、最遠達60公尺，體積縮小35%、重量減輕33%,電池續航最長可達550天，而且這次第一次同時支援iPhone 跟Galaxy 手機。

最後這一點最關鍵，三星現在的SmartTag2能在這張榜單上守住第二名，很大原因是三星Find My網路規模帶來的10.0分滿分生態系分數，如果SmartTag 3真的能跨iOS平台使用，等於補上它跟AirTag 2之間最大的那個缺口，畢竟AirTag 2自己的生態系分數也是滿分10.0。這些都還不會影響今天的排名，因為SmartTag 3還沒正式上市，我也還沒看到任何實測，但接下來這一個月，這絕對是這個品類裡最值得盯著看的產品。Pebblebee 的Clip 5靠自己9.0分的生態系分數守住第三名，如果你想要一支同時支援Apple Find My跟Google 網路的追蹤器，這依然是強力的選擇。

highlights.title: SmartTag 3將在10月7日登場
highlights.body: 三星下一代追蹤器將在韓國跟美國開賣，藍牙距離拉長到前代的三倍，機身更小更輕，電池續航最長可達550天。

highlights.title: 支援iPhone 才是真正的重點
highlights.body: SmartTag 3據傳首次支援iPhone,這個功能一旦成真，將補上三星追蹤器跟AirTag 2之間最大的生態系缺口。

highlights.title: 上市之前排名都不會變
highlights.body: SmartTag 3還沒正式上市，也還沒有任何獨立實測，所以今天的排名維持不變，但接下來這一個月，這是這個品類裡最值得盯著看的產品。

highlights.title: Pebblebee 依然贏在跨平台支援
highlights.body: 9.0分的生態系分數，來自同時支援Apple Find My跟Google 網路這兩套系統，對經常切換手機平台的人來說是真正的優勢。

Samsung's New SmartTag 3 Item Tracker Works With iPhones

en.commentary: AirTag 2 keeps the top spot because Apple's Find My network is still the largest crowd-sourced tracking mesh on earth, and that ecosystem scale is worth more than any single hardware spec when you're trying to find something you actually lost. Samsung's SmartTag2 holds a strong second, and reporting this week confirms the upcoming SmartTag 3 will work across more than just Galaxy phones, including iPhones, which signals Samsung wants to compete directly on cross-platform reach instead of staying locked to its own ecosystem. That's a smart move I'll be watching closely, but the SmartTag 3 hasn't shipped yet, so it doesn't change today's ranking. Pebblebee's Clip 5 continues to earn its third-place spot by working across both Apple Find My and Google's Find Hub network simultaneously, a genuine convenience for mixed-device households that neither Apple's nor Samsung's tracker can match. Eufy's SmartTrack Card E40 remains the thinnest wallet-friendly card tracker that still holds a respectable ecosystem score. Tile's lineup continues to slide in my rankings specifically because its network has shrunk relative to Apple and Google's crowd-sourced alternatives, and that network size is the whole point of a tracker. I found no shipped hardware this week that outperforms the current leaders, so ranks hold steady.

highlights.title: AirTag 2's Find My network size is still unmatched
highlights.body: The sheer number of iPhones acting as crowd-sourced locators makes Apple's ecosystem score a perfect 10, and that's what actually gets a lost item found.

highlights.title: Samsung's upcoming SmartTag 3 signals a cross-platform push
highlights.body: Reports confirm it will work with iPhones as well as Galaxy devices, a strategy shift worth watching even though it hasn't shipped yet.

highlights.title: Pebblebee Clip 5 is the best pick for mixed-device households
highlights.body: Working across both Apple Find My and Google Find Hub simultaneously gives it a flexibility no single-ecosystem tracker can offer.

highlights.title: Tile's shrinking network keeps dragging its rank down
highlights.body: A tracker lives or dies by how many devices are listening for it, and Tile's crowd-sourced base has fallen behind Apple's and Google's networks.

zh-tw.commentary: AirTag 2繼續排第一，因為蘋果的Find My網路還是全世界最大的群眾定位網，當你真的東西丟了要找回來，這種生態規模比任何單一硬體規格都更有用。Samsung SmartTag2穩穩守住第二，這週有報導證實即將推出的SmartTag 3不只支援Galaxy手機，連iPhone也能用，代表Samsung打算直接拚跨平台覆蓋率，不想再侷限在自家生態圈裡。這個策略轉向值得持續關注，不過SmartTag 3還沒正式上市，所以不影響今天的排名。Pebblebee Clip 5能同時支援蘋果Find My跟Google的Find Hub網路，這份便利性是混用不同手機家庭的真實需求，也是蘋果跟Samsung的追蹤器都做不到的，這就是它能穩坐第三的原因。Eufy SmartTrack Card E40依然是最薄的卡片型追蹤器，而且生態圈分數還算不錯，很適合放進錢包。Tile系列在我的排名裡持續下滑，主因是它的網路規模相對蘋果跟Google的群眾定位網愈來愈小，而追蹤器的價值本來就取決於網路規模夠不夠大。這週我沒找到任何已經上市的新品表現超過目前的領先者，所以名次維持不變。

highlights.title: AirTag 2的Find My網路規模依然無人能及
highlights.body: 大量iPhone組成的群眾定位網讓蘋果的生態分數直接拿滿分，而這正是真的能找回失物的關鍵。

highlights.title: Samsung即將推出的SmartTag 3顯示跨平台野心
highlights.body: 報導證實它連iPhone都能用，不只是Galaxy裝置，這個策略轉向值得關注，只是目前還沒上市。

highlights.title: Pebblebee Clip 5是混用不同手機家庭的最佳選擇
highlights.body: 同時支援蘋果Find My跟Google Find Hub，這種靈活度是單一生態圈追蹤器做不到的。

highlights.title: Tile網路規模縮小持續拖累它的名次
highlights.body: 追蹤器的價值取決於有多少裝置在幫忙定位，Tile的群眾網路規模已經落後蘋果跟Google。

references.title: Samsung's new AirTag rival works with more than just Galaxy phones
Samsung's New SmartTag 3 Item Tracker Works With iPhones

en.commentary: Apple's AirTag 2 holds the top spot today on the same U2 ultra-wideband chip upgrade that's kept it here since launch, extending Precision Finding range by roughly 50% over the original and pairing it with a speaker that's 50% louder, real measurable gains that justify its 9.6 range score, the best in this ranking by a clear margin. Samsung's Galaxy SmartTag2 holds second as the best option specifically for Samsung device owners, built exclusively around SmartThings Find, a genuine ecosystem lock-in that works against it for anyone outside Samsung's phone lineup. Pebblebee's Clip 5 holds third on the best battery and ecosystem balance for anyone who isn't locked into a single phone brand, working across both Find My and Android's network without the walled-garden tradeoffs of the top two. I'm seeing continued chatter this week about Chipolo and Pebblebee pushing new hardware with Motorola and Eufy expected to follow with updated models later this year, which keeps me watching the mid-tier of this ranking closely even though nothing has shipped yet that changes today's order. Tile's Pro and Mate continue to hold the bottom of this ranking on a weaker finding network than Apple or Google's, even though Tile's cross-platform compatibility remains a real advantage for mixed-device households. I'm holding every rank steady today.

highlights.title: AirTag 2's U2 Chip Is a Real, Measurable Upgrade
highlights.body: Roughly 50% more Precision Finding range and a 50% louder speaker over the original justify its 9.6 range score, the best here by a clear margin.

highlights.title: SmartTag2 Is Built for One Ecosystem, On Purpose
highlights.body: Exclusive SmartThings Find integration makes it the best choice for Samsung owners and a non-starter for everyone else.

highlights.title: Pebblebee Clip 5 Works Across Both Major Networks
highlights.body: No walled-garden tradeoff here, it spans Find My and Android's network, the right pick if you don't want to be locked to one phone brand.

highlights.title: The Mid-Tier Is Worth Watching This Year
highlights.body: Chipolo and Pebblebee are pushing new hardware, with Motorola and Eufy expected to follow, a real reason to revisit this ranking's middle tier soon.

zh-tw.commentary: Apple的AirTag 2今天還是穩坐冠軍，靠的是從上市就有的U2超寬頻晶片升級，精確查找的範圍比第一代多了大約50%，喇叭音量也大了50%，這些都是真實可量測的進步，撐起這張榜單最高、差距也很明顯的9.6分範圍分數。Samsung的Galaxy SmartTag2排第二，是專門為Samsung裝置用戶打造的最佳選擇，完全綁在SmartThings Find生態系裡，對Samsung手機用戶以外的人來說，這個生態系綁定反而是扣分項。Pebblebee的Clip 5排第三，電池跟生態系的平衡做得最好，適合沒有綁死在單一手機品牌的人，同時支援Find My跟Android網路，不像前兩名有封閉生態系的取捨問題。這週持續聽到Chipolo跟Pebblebee在推新硬體的消息，Motorola跟Eufy據說今年稍晚也會跟進推出更新機型，這讓我會持續密切關注這張榜單的中段，雖然目前還沒有任何正式上市的產品改變今天的排名順序。Tile的Pro跟Mate繼續守在榜單底部，查找網路比Apple或Google的弱，不過Tile的跨平台相容性對混用不同裝置的家庭來說還是個實際優勢。今天的排名全部維持不動。

highlights.title: AirTag 2的U2晶片是真實可量測的升級
highlights.body: 精確查找範圍比第一代多約50%，喇叭音量大50%，撐起這裡差距明顯的最高9.6分範圍分數。

highlights.title: SmartTag2本來就是為單一生態系打造
highlights.body: 完全綁在SmartThings Find上，讓它是Samsung用戶的最佳選擇，卻對其他人不適用。

highlights.title: Pebblebee Clip 5同時支援兩大網路
highlights.body: 沒有封閉生態系的取捨問題，同時支援Find My跟Android網路，不想綁死單一手機品牌的人選這個。

highlights.title: 今年值得持續關注這張榜單的中段
highlights.body: Chipolo跟Pebblebee在推新硬體，Motorola跟Eufy據說也會跟進，這是值得很快重新檢視這張榜單中段的實際理由。
